text: JTEKT Corporation's shares are available on the Tokyo and Nagoya exchanges. Its major (top 10) shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were led by Toyota Motor Corporation with 24.3%, The Master Trust Bank of Japan with 15.7% and Custody Bank of Japan with 8.7%.
short: Toyota Motor is JTEKT's largest holder with 24.3% (March 2026).
